subject: BlueCore renewal: proposed throughput restructure and rate-window update
messages:
From: Kate Reynolds <kate@bluecorelabs.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal conversation + expected Q4 throughput surge

Monica — thanks for the quick turnaround on last quarter's usage report. We're forecasting a material increase in Q4 (product launch) and want to talk renewal: specifically increasing our hosted monthly commit and adjusting the request-level rate window so our SDK callers don't see 429s during short bursts.

Snapshot: BlueCore currently on 5M token/month commit. We expect peak sustained throughput to be ~2.4x current baseline for 6–8 weeks post-launch.

Ask: can Redwood propose a short-term uplift path (temporary burst allowance / higher monthly commit with a smoothing rate window) and an updated price ladder? Also include any recommended canary plan so we don't break production if we change rate windows. Attaching our usage exports.

Thanks,
Kate
VP Product, BlueCore Labs
attachments: BlueCore_usage_May-Jul2027.csv
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kate Reynolds <kate@bluecorelabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-04T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation + expected Q4 throughput surge

Kate — great context, and congrats on the upcoming launch. High-level options below; I'll follow with a formal SOW and a ratecard so procurement has what they need.

Option A — Short-term burst window + moderate commit uplift- New monthly commit: 8M tokens (immediate)- Temporary burst window: 3x per-minute request smoothing for first 60 days (auto-reverts)- Unit price tiers: same as current until commit threshold, then -8% on overage rates for the first 90 days

Option B — Reserved throughput for the campaign (recommended if latency SLO is key)- Dedicated reserved slot (applies to your contract) sized for sustained 2.4x baseline- New monthly commit: 9M tokens + reserved throughput fee (one-time onboarding)- Formal SLA uplift during campaign window

Can you confirm whether BlueCore prefers a symmetric burst (per-minute) or a leaky-bucket that prioritizes latency for short tails? I CC'd Ben to validate runtime implications and Lauren for commercial terms. I'm attaching our latest ratecard for transparency.

Next steps: if you confirm Option A vs B, I'll produce an SOW + DocuSign to get procurement moving.

Best,
Monica Patel
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-ratecard-v3.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-06T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation + expected Q4 throughput surge

Quick technical note on the two options (Monica/Team):

Option A implications:- Burst window (3x per-minute smoothing) is doable without changing model variants. It uses the existing continuous-batching layer and the request router to accept spikes; however, sustained bursts >10 minutes will start to eat KV cache efficiency and bump average latency ~30–120ms on large contexts.- Overages will be billed per normal tiering unless we attach the promo -8% credit.

Option B implications (reserved throughput):- Best for predictability. We reserve GPU capacity and pin a model snapshot/version. This eliminates most of the latency variance during campaign peaks and reduces failure surface for long tails.- Onboarding time: ~7 calendar days to provision and verify canaries.

Recommendation: If BlueCore's launch has hard latency constraints for user-facing flows, Option B is safer. If it's backend batch processing or tolerant to slight latency increases, Option A with a 90-day credit is lower cost and faster.

Also: we'll need to tweak the rate-limit window in the routing policy for the client key to allow short 3x bursts; that is a config change and reversible.

-ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Kate Reynolds <kate@bluecorelabs.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@bluecorelabs.com
Date: 2027-08-09T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation + expected Q4 throughput surge

Thanks — leaning toward Option A to keep cost flexibility, but we'll want the 90-day reduced overage credit and the temporary 3x burst window. Procurement is looped to issue a PO; they'll want a formal SOW and a DocuSign path we can approve.

Two asks for the SOW:
- Explicit rollback plan for rate-window changes (we need automatic revert if error rate > 1.5% for 2 consecutive hours)
- A short canary for the first 48 hours limited to 10% of keys so we can watch user-facing metrics

Procurement (procurement@bluecorelabs.com) — we expect a single PO to cover the revised commit for the remainder of the quarter plus an explicit line for burst overage credits. Please confirm the PO cadence you need.

Kate
VP Product, BlueCore Labs
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kate Reynolds <kate@bluecorelabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@bluecorelabs.com
Date: 2027-08-10T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation + expected Q4 throughput surge — SOW and next steps

Team — attaching the SOW (SOW_BlueCore_Q3.pdf) and the finalized ratecard. Summary of agreed commercials per Option A: 

- New committed monthly tokens: 8,000,000 (effective immediately upon PO/DocuSign)- Temporary burst window: up to 3x per-minute smoothing for first 60 days, auto-reverts at 61st day- Overage credit: -8% on overage unit price for first 90 days after uplift- Canary plan: 48h limited to 10% of keys; rollback trigger: error rate > 1.5% for 2 consecutive hours (automatic revert to pre-uplift routing)

Action items: 
- Monica: create DocuSign envelope and push SOW to Kate (in progress) — link: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/REV-8421-SOW
- Procurement (BlueCore): confirm PO number and target by 2027-08-16 to enable provisioning the same week
- Ben & Engineering: we will schedule a 60-minute provisioning/checklist call for 2027-08-12 to validate canary instrumentation and tracing hooks

I've also created the HubSpot deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7421 (RDW-8421). Please reply-all with PO# when available.

Thanks — excited to get this live and support the launch.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
